Characterization:
- The client is TypeScript compiled to SystemJS `System.register` modules, loaded via `SystemJS.import("main")`.
- It is minified (terser-style local-variable mangling) but NOT obfuscated.
- All 1,257 modules keep their full source paths, for example System.register("data/IniSection") and "game/map/Bridges". Class, method and property names also survive (piecesByTile, connectPiece, updateOverlayData), as do error and log strings, which are template literals.
- This makes near-mechanical de-minification into a TypeScript tree with the same file layout feasible.

Distinctive identifiers:
- DOM root id "ra2web-root", so CD's own internal codename is "ra2web".
- Custom GLSL uniforms "paletteOffsetCount" and "extraLight".
- Storage and file keys "cdncache_", "chronodivide.auth.complete" and "cdexport.zip".
- Localization keys prefixed "ts:", including a "ts:disclaimer" that names Chrono Divide.
- config.ini points to gateway.chronodivide.com, gameres.chronodivide.com and a CORS proxy at game.chronodivide.com/cors-proxy/.
- The code has a typo: "Bridge piece was alredy removed at tile (". It is a useful copy fingerprint.
- The util/retry module ("Unexpected retry state") is a newer addition that none of the repos have.

The module list is in scratchpad/provenance/cd_modules.txt. The literal set used for comparison is in cd_literals.txt: 5,343 unique literals of 24 or more characters.

comparisons.evidence:
Admission in the LICENSE (VERIFIED). Commit 898d891 on 2026-09-03 replaced GPL-3.0 with a notice that reads: "This repository contains code reconstructed from the Chrono Divide client" and that this material "is not licensed under GPL-3.0 or any other open-source license". The README disclaimer says the project is based on analysis of RA2WEB, the Chinese version of Chrono Divide, that all rights belong to CD's owner, and that CD "has never open-sourced the game client code". In issue #39 (https://github.com/huangkaoya/ts-redalert2/issues/39, 2026-03-25) the maintainer replied that the repo is based on analysis of RA2WEB.com and was not written from scratch, and that the original is not open source.

Technical evidence (VERIFIED, HEAD 898d891):
- 1,156 of its 1,267 .ts/.tsx files sit at exactly CD module paths. The two VM repos, used as a control, match 1 path ("main").
- 453 of CD's 5,343 long string literals appear verbatim. The control repos have 2.
- Examples include the CD typo "Bridge piece was alredy removed at tile (" in src/game/map/Bridges.ts, "repath_blocker_busy_wait_timeout" in MoveTask.ts, "Unable to load Idx file, did not find magic number 2, found" in IdxFile.ts and "Random country should have been resolved by now" in GameFactory.ts.
- Bridges.ts follows CD's minified code statement by statement (piecesByTile.set, pieces.add, connectPiece, updateOverlayData(prev/next)) with only local variable names changed.
- CD's shader uniforms paletteOffsetCount (4 files) and extraLight (20 files) are present.
- All 137 `ts:` keys in en-US.json exist in CD with identical values, including CD's own disclaimer that "Chrono Divide" is a non-profit fan project.
- CD's res/img/drag-archive.png, drag-folder.png and download-arrow.png are byte-identical (SHA-1 f0b5ce9a6e84, d458acdd7f42 and e26166b4cb15).
- "cdexport.zip" and "cdncache_" are present.
- The credits screen lists "原项目开发 Chronodivide" (original project developer: Chronodivide). GameLoader.ts calls SystemJS.import('@chronodivide/sp-bots').

Added on top of the CD material: a React/Bun/three 0.183 port and game/ai/thirdpartbot, which is Supalosa's bot and declares no licence ("UNLICENSED").

This is a different kind of project. "RA2 VM" runs the original x86 game.exe/gamemd.exe in the browser using v86, custom firmware (src/vm86/boot.asm), a PE loader and Win32/DirectX/DirectPlay shims. It is not a reimplementation of the engine.

No CD material was found:
- The only CD module-path match is "main".
- 2 of 5,343 CD literals match, both generic: "application/octet-stream" and "Red-Alert-2-Multiplayer.exe". The second is the archive.org installer file name, which both projects happen to use.

GitHub metadata: not a fork, created 2026-09-12, 238 stars, GPL-3.0-or-later. CONTRIBUTORS lists Junlin Liu (@NoCLin) and academic co-authors (HDU). docs/THIRD_PARTY.md lists v86, 7z-wasm, LZMA-JS, Anime4K and SweetFX.

This repo carries a different IP risk that has nothing to do with CD. It executes EA's proprietary binaries. scripts/resources/prepareThirdPartyExes.mts downloads game.exe/gamemd.exe "from third-party shared locations", tests point to archive.org copies of the RA2 installer, and scripts/reverse/ contains disassembly tooling for the RA2 exe. notes:
Bottom line: four of the five named repos (huangkaoya/redalert2 is the same repo as ts-redalert2) are Chrono Divide-derived, and their own README and LICENSE say so. That covers huangkaoya/ts-redalert2 and its two GitHub forks, OpenRA2/RA2Web and DD-Channel/ra2-web.

What that means for anyone building on them (INFERENCE, not legal advice):
- The GPL-3.0 files in OpenRA2 and DD-Channel are older copies of a grant the maintainer himself withdrew on 2026-09-03.
- No evidence shows that Alexandru Ciucă (CD's author) authorised any of these repos.
- Building the remaster on this family means building on unlicensed copies of proprietary code, which the rights holder can take down at any time.
- Clean options for the user to weigh:
  - (a) Ask CD's author for written permission, through the Discord or X/Twitter links on chronodivide.com.
  - (b) Use the independent GPL \"RA2 VM\" (ra2-games/ra2). It is legally cleaner with respect to CD, but it runs EA's original exe. That means the user must own the game and not use the repo's third-party exe downloads, and HD work is limited to post-process upscaling and shaders.
  - (c) An independent GPL engine such as OpenRA with an RA2 mod. I did not check this one in this task.

Methodology: exact module-path matching against CD's 1,257 SystemJS module names; exact matching of CD string literals of 24+ characters, with the two VM repos as a negative control; SHA-1 checks on assets; key-by-key locale comparison; GitHub API fork metadata.

Limits:
- CD v0.84.0 is newer than the repo snapshots (2025-2026), so match rates understate the overlap.
- The CSDN and Zhihu content could not be checked.
